title: Code and data for: How much of a hyperbolic orbifold does heat hear?; Finitely many eigenvalues determine the signature of a hyperbolic orbifold; Triples with equal sum and equal reciprocal sum
description:
Code, data and manuscript sources for three papers by the same authors: How much of a hyperbolic orbifold does heat hear? (heat invariants of closed hyperbolic 2-orbifolds and how many of them determine the signature), Finitely many eigenvalues determine the signature of a hyperbolic orbifold (an effective inverse spectral result with an a-posteriori test on computed spectra), and Triples with equal sum and equal reciprocal sum (the arithmetic of the triples of cone orders that two heat invariants do not distinguish).

The deposit contains the exact-arithmetic verification suite, the proofs' checking scripts and their outputs, the exhaustive enumeration data, the finite-element eigenvalue data of the triangle orbifolds and of a moduli family, the figure sources, and the LaTeX sources of the three manuscripts. One command, code/run_all.sh, reruns every check from the committed data and reports PASS, FAIL or SKIP for each stage; DATA-MANIFEST.md lists every data file with its size, SHA-256 checksum and generating program. The pinned Python requirements are in requirements.txt; re-solving the eigenvalue problems needs numerics/requirements.txt (NGSolve), and the rank certification needs theory/diophantine/requirements-pari.txt (cypari2, PARI/GP).
